d: Job Title – Senior SAP Technical Consultant

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.

A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS_News.
q: SAP S/4HANA: 10+ years of total SAP experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in S/4HANA technical roles.
ABAP & Development: Expert-level proficiency in ABAP, ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, AMDP, and RAP.
Integration: Strong experience with SAP PI/PO, CPI, IDocs, RFC, and REST/OData APIs.
Database: Deep understanding of SAP HANA database architecture, SQLScript, and performance tuning.
Cloud: Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) and cloud-native development.
r: Lead end-to-end technical design, development, and deployment of SAP S/4HANA solutions (On-premise, Private Cloud, or Public Cloud).
Architect and optimize complex integrations using SAP Integration Suite, CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), and OData services.
Perform technical assessments, gap analysis, and migration strategies for S/4HANA conversions (Brownfield/Greenfield).
Develop custom ABAP objects, including ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), AMDP, and Core Data Services (CDS) views.
Identify opportunities to integrate SAP AI Core, SAP AI Business Services, and SAP Joule into existing S/4HANA landscapes.
Collaborate with data scientists and AI teams to embed predictive analytics, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision capabilities into SAP workflows.
Design and implement AI-driven automation for processes such as intelligent invoice processing, demand forecasting, and predictive maintenance.
Ensure data quality and governance standards are met to support AI/ML model training and inference within the SAP ecosystem.
Conduct performance tuning and HANA database optimization to ensure high availability and low latency.
Implement security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC) and data encryption.
Mentor junior technical consultants and provide thought leadership on SAP technology trends.

You will also coordinate closely with internal sales, technical, delivery, customer success, and support teams to ensure customer needs are met and measurable business outcomes are achieved.

As a trusted advisor, you will develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business objectives, challenges, and strategic priorities, positioning the organization as a long-term partner and ensuring strong customer satisfaction, engagement, and commercial growth.
